content.title: Ohio State men's basketball falls to TCU in NCAA Tournament first round
content.text: Updated March 19, 2026, 2:49 p.m. ETThe Ohio State men's basketball team made a furious comeback in the second half of its NCAA Tournament game against TCU, but fell to the Horned Frogs 66-64.At halftime, No. 8 seed OSU trailed the No. 9 Horned Frogs 39-24. The Buckeyes held TCU to 9-for-28 shooting after the break and grabbed three second-half steals while blocking two shots. They picked up offensively as well, making 14 of their 29 shots with 10 assists while limiting themselves to just one turnover.However, TCU's Xavier Edmonds laid a shot up and in with 4.3 seconds remaining, while Bruce Thornton's subsequent half-court shot was off for Ohio State.Thornton finished with just 10 points. John Mobley led Ohio State with 15, Devin Royal had 14, and Amare Bynum chipped in 12.TCU will go on to face the winner of Duke and Siena.Here's how the game played out. The Buckeyes lost 66-64 to TCU. Tie game!26.3 seconds left in second half: Ohio State 64, TCU 64Ohio State's Bruce Thornton's first made field goal of the second half was a 3-pointer that tied the game. TCU has the ball. David Harding hurt2:08 left in second half: Ohio State 59, TCU 58Ohio State's Bruce Thornton was running downhill and TCU's David Harding tried to intercept him on his way to the basket. It did not end well for Harding, who was hit in the head twice, once with Thornton's arm as Thornton went up to the basket and again when Harding collided with the floor. Harding has eight points today.To add insult to injury, Thornton made his resulting free throws to give OSU the lead back. David Punch makes OSU pay3:45 left in second half: TCU 58, Ohio State 57David Punch registered his third block on the day, rejecting Christoph Tilly's attempted dunk, and went to the other end and slammed it home himself. So, even though the Buckeyes have made seven of their last nine shot attempts, they are down now. Ohio State takes lead7:05 left in second half: Ohio State 51, TCU 50Ohio State has made its last four shot attempts and is on an 11-1 run over the last 2:43. Xavier Edmonds leaves for TCU8:02 left in second half: TCU 50, Ohio State 49Ohio State has pulled within a point, and TCU's Xavier Edmonds (11 points) has had to leave the game after picking up a fourth foul. OSU's Bruce Thornton has zero second-half baskets9:05 left in second half: TCU 49, Ohio State 44Ohio State senior captain Bruce Thornton is scoreless since the break. He has taken just one 3-point shot attempt. Ohio State's reserves have contributed no scoring to this point; that's probably a wash considering that the Horned Frogs have just four bench points. Ohio State Buckeyes draw closer with big run11:43 left in second half: TCU 46, Ohio State 40Ohio State men's basketball went on a 10-0 run over 2:10. TCU is just 2 for 14 in the second half shooting. John Mobley has eight of OSU's last 12 points. John Mobley pacing Ohio State14:10 left in second half: TCU 43, Ohio State 33John Mobley has 10 points for OSU. Amare Bynum has added eight. Christoph Tilly has scored six, while Bruce Thornton has been held to five.But the defense is picking up for the Buckeyes. TCU is just 1 of 10 from the field in the second half. TCU leading despite David Punch's foul troubles17:55 left in second half: TCU 39, Ohio State 28TCU's leading scorer David Punch was limited to 9 minutes in the first half and scored just three points. The forward had picked up two early fouls. TCU defense making it tough on Ohio State2:28 left in first half: TCU 31, Ohio State 24Ohio State is moving the ball, as shown by its eight assists on 10 baskets, but it's not getting shots to fall, although the Buckeyes are warming up. They've improved their shooting percentage to 40%. Credit the Horned Frogs for making things difficult. TCU has four steals and three blocks. Ohio State can't get over the hump vs TCU men's basketball6:08 left in first half: TCU 23, Ohio State 18Ohio State has trailed for 11:24 of today's game. Although John Mobley Jr. is 3 for 4 from the field for seven points, OSU as a team is shooting just 35% from the field. Buckeyes finding some offense10:39 left in first half: TCU 14, Ohio State 13All five of Ohio State's starters have scored, with Bruce Thornton (5 points) leading the way. However, Ohio State still trails as Brock Harding (5 points) is pacing the Horned Frogs. Ohio State struggling down low12:20 left in first half: TCU 12, Ohio State 9OSU did not score any points in the paint until there was 12:20 left in the first half and missed on its first three layup attempts. Bruce Thornton finally connected on a floater in the lane. Ohio State falls behind early15:22 left in first half: TCU 8, Ohio State 5TCU is on a 6-0 run and Ohio State has missed its last four shot attempts to allow the Horned Frogs to jump ahead at the first media timeout. Punch blocks Tilly17:20 left in first half: TCU 6, Ohio State 5Some early notes from OSU's game against TCU include John Mobley has not gotten a shot off, the Buckeyes have shown an early 2-3 zone, and Horned Frogs 6-foot-7 forward David Punch blocked a shot attempt by Ohio State 7-footer Christoph Tilly. Puff Johnson was part of North Carolina’s run to the championship game in 2022, and Josh Ojianwuna played in four NCAA Tournament games as a freshman and sophomore at Baylor in 2023 and 2024. Additionally, Wright State made the Big Dance when Brandon Noel was part of the team, but that was a redshirt season for him. Before the 2026 men's NCAA Tournament, when was the last time OSU made the Big Dance?Ohio State missed the NCAA Tournament in coach Chris Holtmann's final two seasons. (Jake Diebler took over as interim coach on Feb. 14 of the 2022-23 campaign.) And OSU was one of the first four teams voted out of last year's March Madness, Diebler's first full season as the Buckeyes' bench boss.So, this is the first trip to the NCAA Tournament for Ohio State since 2022, when the seventh-seeded Buckeyes beat Loyola Chicago in the opening round and before falling to No. 2 seed Villanova in the second round. Who will referee today's Ohio State men's basketball NCAA Tournament game?Officiating today will be the crew of Michael Greenstein, Willia Covington and Chad Barlow. The Buckeyes are 52-30 all-time in March Madness, with one title coming in 1960.At the same time, this is TCU’s 12th appearance in the NCAA Tournament. The Frogs are 7-11 all-time in the Big Dance.
